add_sample.title: Add a calibration sample
add_sample.description:
Enter what your **external meters** say right now. The device's own readings are taken from the current poll — you do not type them, because once a calibration is active the sensors are corrected and a sample copied from them would measure the leftover error and stack it on the correction already applied.

This poll reports **{charge} W** charging, **{out} W** out, **{in} W** in (raw registers, uncorrected). {count} sample(s) recorded so far.

The device must be charging — the error does not appear otherwise. Give at least one figure; both also derives the true charge power, which checks the device's own charge reading.

For a second sample that resolves whether the error scales, change the AC charging power setting first so the charge rate differs.

data.out_true: Output power, true — what the load reports (W)

review_samples.title: Calibration samples

error.sample_needs_a_pair: A sample needs a true and reported value for the output, the input, or both — otherwise there is no error to measure.
error.sample_needs_charging: The device is not charging, and the error only appears while it is. Raise the charge ceiling above the current battery level and try again.

abort.no_data: The device has not been polled yet, so there are no readings to pair with. Try again once it is connected.
abort.no_samples: No calibration samples have been recorded yet.
